To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(i) fluorine substituent in arylboronic acid derivatives influences their properties; (ii) fluorine substituent influences acidity and hydrolytic stability of boronic acids and esters, but not their spectroscopic properties; (iii) fluorine substitutents in boronic acids, esters, benzoboroxoles and boroxins have different influence on their properties; (iv) fluorine-substituted boron-containing compounds are important for many applications, especially

(i) the electron withdrawing character and steric hindrance of fluoro substituents influence the Lewis acidity of arylborinic acids, (ii) the hydrolytic stability of arylborinate esters is strongly dependent on the electron withdrawing character, steric hindrance and number of fluorine substitutents, (iii) borinic acid derivatives, such as benzoxaboroles are more stable in water than borinate esters and borinic acids, (iv)
the presence of fluorine atoms in the phenyl group of the boronic compounds leads to significant change in their properties.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the chemistry of fluoro-substituent containing phenylboronic derivatives and the influence of these substituents on their properties.
the synthesis, properties and applications of fluoro-substitued boronic acids.
the influence of the fluorine substituent on the properties of the compounds containing boron atoms.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the influence of fluorine substituent on the properties of the compounds is not simple.

the influence of the fluorine substituent on the properties of arylboron compounds is very strong and it is possible to tune the properties of these compounds by varying the number and position of fluorine atoms.
fluoro-substituents have an important influence on the properties of boronic compounds.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the presence of fluorine atoms in the phenylboronic acid molecule influences Lewis acidity, stability in solution as well hydrolytic stability of the compounds.
fluoro-substituents influence properties of boronic acids and derivatives in a similar way to the effect of electron withdrawing substituents in organic chemistry.
the introduction of the electron withdrawing groups into the arylboronic compounds can significantly change their Lewis acidity.
